description: This Java class defines the DepositAccountInterestIncentives entity, which models interest incentives related to deposit accounts in the Fineract financial platform. It includes fields for interest incentivization details and links to interest rate chart slabs.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestIncentives
classes.description: Entity representing interest incentives for deposit accounts, linked to interest rate chart slabs and containing interest incentive fields.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Factory method to create a new DepositAccountInterestIncentives instance with specified interest rate chart slabs and interest incentives fields.

methods.name: updateDepositAccountInterestRateChartSlabs
methods.description: Updates the associated interest rate chart slabs for this incentive.

methods.name: interestIncentivesFields
methods.description: Returns the interest incentives fields associated with this entity.
